name: Phrase counting: 32 bars
lesson:
## The 32-bar section

A1 on bars 1 and 33, A2 on bars 17 and 49, A3 on every other 8-bar line (9, 25, 41, 57). Three pads, three levels of the same count: the 32-bar section, its 16-bar halves, the 8-bar phrases inside them.

Drops, breakdowns and full mix-ins in dance music sit on 32-bar boundaries. If you can only count to 8 you will mix into the right bar of the wrong section, which sounds fine for 8 bars and then falls apart. Keep the metronome off once you pass this; the aim is an internal count that survives a noisy booth.

tracks.cue: Extended club mix: drum intro for two 16-bar phrases, chords on the third. A1 on the first kick and on the chord entry (bar 33); A2 on 17 and 49; A3 on every 8.
Drum intro for two 16-bar phrases, the arpeggio riff on the third. Your bar-33 A1 should coincide with the riff.
E-Werk Club Mix: bassline on the third 16-bar phrase, melody a phrase later. The 32-bar count puts A1 on each of those entries.
